abilities.name: Fragrance Extraction

_curatorNotes: Spiritbreath Thorn (Ousia arkhe): fires on E cast with a 10s arkhe cooldown (gcsim skill.go arkheAttack, skillArkeCD=10, hitmark 62f). 69.34% ATK @T10. The E cast hit itself (84.74% @T10, hitmark 37f) follows the FrameMap convention and is not authored as an effect.

abilities.description:
Creates a Lumidouce Case that deals AoE Dendro DMG.

Lumidouce Case
·Fires Puffs of Puredew at nearby opponents at intervals, dealing Dendro DMG.
·When nearby opponents are affected by Burning, they will give off Scents at intervals, and 1 Scent can be created this way every 2s. The Lumidouce Case collects nearby Scents. The Lumidouce Case will level up after gathering 2 of them, after which it will fire 1 extra Puff of Puredew when firing, while the DMG dealt by and DMG AoE of the above attack will also be increased.
·1 Lumidouce Case created by Emilie herself can exist at any one time. The Case starts at Level 1 and can go up to Level 2. If the Case does not collect any Scents for 8s while it is on the field, it will go back to Level 1.

Arkhe: Pneuma
At intervals, after Emilie creates a Lumidouce Case this way, a Spiritbreath Thorn will descend in front of her and pierce her opponent, dealing Pneuma-aligned Dendro DMG.

summons.label: Lumidouce Case

_curatorNotes: Canonical assumption: Level 2 case (scent upgrade reached quickly in sustained combat vs Burning targets). Ladder @T10: L1 = 71.28% single hit / L2 = 151.2% ×2 hits per 1.5s tick (second hit +18f) / L3 (burst-only) = 391%. Marker shows tick start; the L2 double-hit and per-level dynamics (gcsim lumidouce.go: Mult skillLumidouce[level-1]) are not per-marker modeled.

icdGate authored 2026-08-17 (ICD-group round b): gcsim lumidouce.go:66 sets ICDGroupEmilieLumidouce on the case's tick, whose table entry is a 120f reset window in which only the FIRST hit applies. Measured 5/9 applied, which standard also gives at this 90f interval — authored on the GROUP, not on the coincidence. ⚠️ Her BURST's case is deliberately left bare, and pairing by eye is why: gcsim runs the Level-3 phase on ICDGroupDefault and only the decayed Level-1 stream carries this group, while the burst's authored series models the Level-3 phase.

firstTickDelay 1.5833 (95f) authored 2026-09-17 (T1.5): gcsim lumidouce.go queues the first attack at lumidouceTickInterval (90f) and lands it after caseTravel (default 5f), so the first hit is spawn + 95 — the dump's 111f from cast (16 + 95). It had defaulted to the interval, 5f early on all fourteen ticks.

terminatesOn 'recast' + ONE LABEL for all three Cases (2026-09-17, T1.5). The kit: '1 Lumidouce Case created by Emilie herself can exist at any one time', and gcsim keys every case on one `lumidouceSrc` — a new spawn (E recast, the burst's Level 3 Case, or the Case the burst leaves behind) re-keys it and the previous Case's attack chain stops. Recast truncation keys on the summon LABEL, so the burst's two Cases carry this label too; that is what lets the burst stow this Case at its spawn.

abilities.name: Aromatic Explication
abilities.description:
Guiding the fragrances collected within the Case, Emilie converts them into pure Dendro energy, creating a Level 3 Lumidouce Case and stowing existing Cases away.
While it exists, the Level 3 Lumidouce Case will not gather nearby Scents, but it will continuously cause Scented Dew to descend, attacking opponents within range and dealing Dendro DMG. During this time, 1 drop of Scented Dew will descend every 0.3 seconds, and 1 opponent can become the target every 0.7 seconds.
When the duration ends, a Level 1 Lumidouce Case will be recreated. If a Lumidouce Case was stowed away when using Aromatic Explication, then the Case that was stowed away will be deployed instead, and its duration will be reset.
While Aromatic Explication is active, the Elemental Skill "Fragrance Extraction" will not create a Lumidouce Case.

summons.label: Lumidouce Case

_curatorNotes: CADENCE CORRECTED 2026-08-18 (tick-cap round follow-up), and the old 0.7s was the MARK duration rather than a cadence. gcsim burst.go: the volley task runs every burstTickInterval = 18f and picks a random enemy that does NOT carry burstMarkKey, marking it for burstMarkDuration = 42f. Single-target, the mark can therefore only expire ON an 18f volley boundary, so the deliberate re-target cadence is ceil(42/18) x 18 = 54f = 0.9s, not 0.7s. First hit lands at the first volley (18f) plus burstHitmark (12f) = 30f after spawn, hence firstTickDelay 0.5. Measured: gcsim hits at +126/+180/+234, which is exactly what this now draws (spawnsAt 96 + 30, then 54f apart, three ticks inside the 2.8s window).

NO tickCap, and ⚓ THE KIT TEXT IS THE REASON, not a positional judgement (re-justified 2026-08-18 after Nate asked whether an always-output tick was being refused on AOE grounds - a fair challenge, and the first version of this note gave the weaker answer). The burst description states the cap outright: "1 drop of Scented Dew will descend every 0.3 seconds, and 1 opponent can become the target every 0.7 seconds." The drop ALWAYS descends - we are not refusing an output - but the game itself forbids the same opponent being targeted inside 0.7s, and on a 0.3s grid the earliest legal re-target is 0.9s. That is the cadence above. gcsim shows a FOURTH Level-3 hit at +162 because when every enemy is marked its volley falls back to CalcRandomPointFromCenter and that random point's 2.5-radius blast happened to clip the target - an artifact of gcsim needing to send the drop SOMEWHERE, not a hit the game grants. ⚠️ The audit will keep flagging count 3 -> 4 for this reason; that flag is expected, not a backlog item.

Level 3 barrage: gcsim fires volleys every 0.3s at random unmarked enemies, marking each for 0.7s (burst.go burstTickInterval/burstMarkDuration) — the single-target cadence that produces is the 0.9s above. ↻ 2026-09-17 (T1.5): C4's +2s and 0.4s mark are authored (durationModifiers on this Case, a gated 0.6s twin of this series), and the Case recreated at 306f is the burst's second summon — this line used to say all three were unmodelled.

C4 cadence (2026-09-17, T1.5), authored as the same series twice with exclusive conditions (the Aino/Ororon shape). C4 cuts the per-target mark by 0.3s (gcsim burst.go: burstMarkDuration -= 0.3*60 → 24f). On the 18f volley grid the earliest legal re-target is ceil(24/18) × 18 = 36f = 0.6s; the first hit is unchanged at spawn + 30f. With the +2s the Case lives 288f: eight hits, not three.

LABEL (2026-09-17, T1.5): was 'Lumidouce Case (Level 3)'. It carries the E Case's label so it STOWS that Case at its spawn — recast truncation keys on the label, and the kit's 'stowing existing Cases away' is gcsim re-keying `lumidouceSrc`, which stops the E Case's attack chain. Before this the E Case kept ticking through the burst. The Level is in the burst's own name and description.
C4 +2s (burst.go: extendDuration 2*60) as durationModifiers — only summons[0] reads them, which is why this Case stays first.

summons.label: Lumidouce Case

_curatorNotes: Mirrors the E Case's series exactly (canonical Level 2, 90f cadence, ICDGroupEmilieLumidouce, first hit at spawn + 95f). gcsim respawns the Case at the level it had when the burst stowed it, or Level 1 if none was out; both levels land one application per tick under this group, so the gauge cannot tell them apart.

The Case the burst leaves behind (2026-09-17, T1.5). Kit: 'When the duration ends, a Level 1 Lumidouce Case will be recreated. If a Lumidouce Case was stowed away … the Case that was stowed away will be deployed instead, and its duration will be reset.' gcsim burst.go queues spawnLumidouceCase at burstResetLumidouce = 306f from the cast (+120 at C4) with a full skillDuration (22s) — measured 401f / 90f × 14 in the frames report, which is this spawn + 95.

⚠️ NO terminatesOn, on purpose: a flag would truncate the Level 3 Case at 306f, which at C4 is still alive until 384f. It is ended by the NEXT spawn that carries the flag (an E recast or the next burst), which is the behaviour it needs.
⚠️ spawnsAt is static, so at C4 this Case is drawn 120f early (306 rather than 426) — caveated on C4. No summon field takes a constellation condition.

nonHitting (non-hitting casts round, 2026-09-16 (docs/nonhitting-casts-round.md §1)): gcsim emilie/burst.go:35-70 queues only the Lv3 Lumidouce Case spawn at f96; its ticks (≈f126 on) are the summon series.

passives.name: Lingering Fragrance
passives.description: Each time it collects 2 Scents, the Level 2 Lumidouce Case will consume Scents and release Cleardew Cologne that deals AoE Dendro DMG equal to 600% of Emilie's ATK to opponents. This DMG is not considered Elemental Skill DMG.

passives.name: Rectification
passives.description: Emilie deals increased DMG to Burning opponents based on her ATK, with every 1,000 ATK increasing DMG dealt by 15%. The maximum DMG bonus that can be gained this way is 36%.

constellations.name: Light Fragrance Leaching
constellations.description:
Increases the DMG dealt by Fragrance Extraction and her Ascension Talent's Cleardew Cologne "Lingering Fragrance" by 20%. The latter requires unlocking said Ascension Talent first.
Additionally, when nearby party members trigger the Burning reaction on opponents or deal Dendro DMG to Burning opponents, they will generate an additional Scent. This effect can be triggered once every 2.9s.

constellations.name: Lakelight Top Note
_curatorNotes: 2026-05-11 (queue item 3): migrated `manual` → two `onHit` effects (one for Fragrance Extraction skill, one for Aromatic Explication burst). Added missing `element: dendro`, `source: character`, `durationType: refresh`. Cleardew Cologne (A4-produced item) hits aren't separately tracked — they share the skill/burst dispatch site in practice. Renders via existing resShred bar treatment.
constellations.description: When Fragrance Extraction, Aromatic Explication, or Cleardew Cologne produced by the Ascension Talent "Lingering Fragrance" (the last of which requires Ascension Talent activation) hits opponents, those opponents' Dendro RES is decreased by 30% for 10s.

constellations.name: Marcotte Sillage
constellations.description:
When using Fragrance Extraction or Aromatic Explication, Emilie will gain Abiding Fragrance for 5s.
While this is active, after Emilie uses Normal or Charged Attacks, she will generate 1 Scent, and her Normal and Charged Attack DMG will be converted into Dendro DMG that cannot be overridden, and the DMG dealt will be increased by 300% of Emilie's ATK.

The Abiding Fragrance effect will be removed after 4 Scents are created this way or after its duration expires. Abiding Fragrance can be triggered once every 12s.
constellations.caveat: Normal and Charged Attacks are drawn as Dendro for the full 5s. In game Abiding Fragrance ends early after 4 of them.
_curatorNotes: C6 as an `infuse` (2026-09-17, T1.5), the Kazuha C6 shape: onCast with no ability fires on both E and Q. gcsim cons.go: c6() opens c6ModKey for 5s behind a 12s c6ICDKey — `procCooldown 12` — and applyC6Bonus sets Element = Dendro, IgnoreInfusion on Normal/Extra attacks. gcsim opens it at the Case SPAWN (16f after E, 96f after Q), not the cast; the window here starts at the cast.

Retired: a `manual` damage effect (300% ATK) that reached no surface — it is the flat DMG added to the converted attacks (`ai.FlatDmg += TotalAtk * 3`), a damage-formula term with no bar. The 4-Scent early end is caveated.
